headline: Federal Reserve Proposes Rule Modernization on Bank Insider Lending
summary: The Federal Reserve Board issued proposed rulemaking to modernize Regulation O, updating dollar thresholds for inflation and offering compliance relief for passive fund complexes that lend to corporate insiders.
why: Regulation O establishes strict guardrails on bank extensions of credit to executive officers, directors, and major shareholders to prevent conflicts of interest.

impacts.name: US Commercial Banking
impacts.why: Updated inflation thresholds and passive fund exclusions ease administrative lending compliance.
